notes.title: Updates Ver.1.200
notes.notes:
I・S・U  Updates History

#ver.1.200 [latest]
===Game balance changes
--Changed AI patterns.
--Adjusted the start position when 3P play.
--Adjust the behavior at the wall.
--Adjust the behavior when SIT inputed.

===Each characters change
==Histoire
-Strengthen: Holding TACKLE to change  pushing direction.

==Fadia
-Effect: Added effects to missiles.
-Effect: Added effects to transform.

==Iwan
-Weakening: SP gauge required 90→180.
-Strengthen: Tackle invincible +1f.
-Change: Tackle invincible -10f.

==Pak-ssu
-Strengthen: SP gauge required 90→60.

==Wunala
-Strengthen: SP gauge required 60→45.

==La Suicida
-Strengthen: Expanded the attack range of STRIKE.
-Strengthen: the damage of STRIKE 10→12.

==Shanti
-Change: Made TACKLE's pushing depending on the meditation level .

===Effect changes
--Added darkening during EX ARTS.
--Added effects when seated.
--Made a particle shape when damaged circle. 
--You can back to the select scene if you hold down Back button.
--Made game stopping for 30 frames when someone is dying.

===New option(Please initialize options when you play training menu.)
--Added camera to adjust scale to show everyone. (default setting)
--Added camera to adjust scale to show everyone. (default setting)
--Added collision detection to chair and players. (default is OFF)
--Displayed player's HP at foot (default is ON)
--Displayed a crown above the head of the player near the win(default is ON)

==Other changes
--Changed the icon.

notes.title: Demo version is released
notes.notes:
In Demo version, 
-You can play only 4 characters (Histoire, Kokuzo, Dafu, La Suicida).
-You can play only 3 modes (Arcade, VS, Lesson).
-You can't change the rule by option
-You can fail only 3 times in Arcade mode.

If you are interested in I・S・U even a bit, please play Demo version.
